title: Arbeidsmiljøloven §§ 14-5 to 14-7, 14-9 and 15-6: the written employment contract
source: Lov om arbeidsmiljø, arbeidstid og stillingsvern mv. (arbeidsmiljøloven), LOV-2005-06-17-62, as amended by lov 15. desember 2023 nr. 88 in force 1 July 2024. Read on lovdata.no 2026-10-09.
note: A drafting check, not legal advice: the scripted rules read whether a particular is there, never whether a term is lawful.

rules.text: A written contract is in place within seven days of the start when the employment runs more than a month, and at once when it runs less or the worker is hired out.
The contract gives the parties, the workplace (or that the work moves, with the employer's business address), the work or title, and the start.
A temporary hire gives its expected length and its basis under § 14-9.
A probation gives its length; at most six months, and in a temporary hire at most half its length.
Holidays and holiday pay, how the holiday is fixed, and any other paid absence; the notice periods and how the employment ends.
The pay at the start with each supplement and benefit (pension, board, night allowance) stated separately, how and when it is paid.
The length and placing of the daily and weekly hours, and the breaks.

Any special working-time arrangement, shift changes and work beyond the agreed hours with its pay, collective agreements and who made them, the user undertaking of a hired-out worker, training the employer offers, and the social security the employer provides with the institutions paid.
Only items g to k, m, p and q may be given by pointing to a law, a regulation or a collective agreement.
Work abroad for more than four consecutive weeks: the countries and length, the currency, the benefits and the terms of the journey home, agreed before departure.
The contract is written in Norwegian throughout, headings included.
rules.source: house rule for a Norwegian document
